dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Is there some matter of importance you wish to discuss with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: This is a comfortable environment, a good place to be calm and gather one's thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Much like the days in the Jade Chamber...

choices.text: Surely this place doesn't compare to the Jade Chamber...?

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Oh, you misunderstand.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: An environment can't be judged purely on its size or opulence.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I sense the time and effort that you have put into this place, which reminds me of the time and effort I myself spent when constructing the Jade Chamber.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Or, to put it another way, I see this as the "Jade Chamber" that belongs to you.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Please. Kindness has nothing to do with it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: A chat? Is there some commercial matter you wish to inquire about?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: N—No... just a simple chat.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Hmm, interesting... so many merchants and business magnates, vying to invite me to dinner.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: And you wish to have a "simple chat"?

choices.text: I don't think I could afford the dinners they're buying.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Haha... Ahh, you make me laugh.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: These people... they send me the most extravagant gifts...

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: ...But all they're really after are my words... any morsel of information that may hint at Liyue's future commercial trends.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Which makes the prospect of a carefree, honest chat here with you... all the more valuable to me.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: For it is something that Mora cannot buy.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: So, stay with me a while, and let's chat about the simpler things in life. Anything at all.

choices.text: We can talk about anything you like.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: ...You really are quite different from the rest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: As a matter of fact... there is something I've been planning for a while now.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: The next time we have an important policy decision on our hands, I'd like you to get involved.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Not exactly... I was thinking that you would be involved in the decision itself.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Rest assured, I am not prone to misjudgment.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: The fount of knowledge and boldness of spirit that your travels have bequeathed upon you are sure to imbue your policies with rare and valuable foresight.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I have no doubt.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Oh, that reminds me.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: After the decision is made, if you could please shred any documentation that accumulates on the wall during the process.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Liyue is due another paper snowstorm. This time, you will be the one to change the prevailing weather.

choices.text: I will rise to the challenge.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I like your boldness of spirit.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: The world of commerce is a battleground, and policy-making requires conviction and decisiveness.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: All that you have experienced during your travels is sure to imbue your policies with rare and valuable foresight.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I will give it my all.

choices.text: To study the thinking behind policy-making?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Morning, Ningguang!

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: If you encounter any difficulties on your travels, feel free to tell me all about them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Ningguang.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: #Good night to you too, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Try to relax and enjoy yourself while you're here. Get some rest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I have observed Liyue from the Jade Chamber for years — every building and every tile is etched into my memory.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I cannot sense the slightest feeling of discord from this street... It is quite a rare find indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Your ability never ceases to surprise me...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: This is a fine study.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: The books here are considered quite rare. And those material catalogs from Mondstadt, hmm... perhaps they might provide some competitive market advantage.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: If I had to say one thing, it would be that the decorations are a little simple. It wouldn't hurt to consider adding more... presentable articles of furniture.
